meta.title: Comprehensive Codebase Optimization & Testing Maturity Audit
meta.purpose: Master prompt to ensure all systems are production-grade, optimized, and fully tested

prompt.instruction: Execute a comprehensive audit and optimization of the entire Heiwa House codebase. This is a BLOCKING task - do not skip any section. For each area, identify issues, fix them immediately, and verify the fix works. Document everything.

phases.name: Database Optimization Audit
tasks: Connect to Supabase and run EXPLAIN ANALYZE on all frequently-used queries
Identify missing indexes on foreign keys and frequently-queried columns
Check for N+1 query patterns in API routes
Verify all tables have proper RLS policies enabled
Audit database schema for normalization issues
Check for orphaned records and referential integrity
Verify all NOT NULL constraints are properly set
Add indexes for: client_ids, booking dates, room_id, status fields
Review and optimize Supabase Edge Functions if any
Check connection pooling configuration
commands: PGPASSWORD='...' psql -h db.pguipwhrxdzzrndbluxb.supabase.co -U postgres -d postgres -c "SELECT schemaname, tablename, indexname FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname = 'public';"
PGPASSWORD='...' psql -h db.pguipwhrxdzzrndbluxb.supabase.co -U postgres -d postgres -c "SELECT relname, seq_scan, idx_scan FROM pg_stat_user_tables ORDER BY seq_scan DESC;"
PGPASSWORD='...' psql -h db.pguipwhrxdzzrndbluxb.supabase.co -U postgres -d postgres -c "SELECT * FROM pg_stat_statements ORDER BY total_time DESC LIMIT 20;"
expected_outputs: List of all indexes (should cover all FK and query columns)
Sequential vs index scan ratio (index scans should dominate)
Slow query identification and optimization plan

phases.name: API Endpoint Audit
tasks: Map ALL API routes in app/api/** directory
Verify each endpoint has proper error handling (try-catch)
Check all endpoints validate input before processing
Ensure all endpoints return consistent response format
Verify authentication/authorization on protected routes
Check for rate limiting on public endpoints
Audit for SQL injection vulnerabilities
Audit for XSS vulnerabilities in response data
Check all endpoints handle edge cases (null, undefined, empty)
Verify proper HTTP status codes are returned
Check for memory leaks in long-running operations
Ensure all database queries use parameterized queries

phases.name: Frontend Performance Audit
tasks: Run Lighthouse audit on all main pages
Check for unnecessary re-renders with React DevTools
Verify all images use Next.js Image component with proper sizing
Check bundle size with next/bundle-analyzer
Identify and code-split large components
Verify proper use of useMemo, useCallback, React.memo
Check for memory leaks in useEffect cleanup
Audit CSS for unused styles
Verify lazy loading on below-fold content
Check Web Vitals: LCP, FID, CLS
Ensure proper caching headers on static assets
Verify service worker configuration (if applicable)

phases.name: Testing Infrastructure Maturity
tasks: Audit existing test coverage (aim for 80%+)
Create missing unit tests for all utility functions
Create integration tests for all API endpoints
Create E2E tests for critical user flows
Set up test database with seed data
Configure CI/CD to run tests on every PR
Add snapshot tests for critical UI components
Create performance regression tests
Set up visual regression testing
Add accessibility testing (axe-core)
Create load testing scripts for API endpoints
Document testing strategy and conventions

phases.name: Security Audit
tasks: Run npm audit and fix all vulnerabilities
Check all environment variables are properly secured
Verify API keys are not exposed in client-side code
Audit authentication flow for vulnerabilities
Check CORS configuration
Verify CSP headers are set
Check for sensitive data in logs
Audit file upload handling (if any)
Verify Stripe webhook signature validation
Check rate limiting on auth endpoints
Audit admin routes for proper authorization
Review Supabase RLS policies

phases.name: Code Quality & Maintainability
tasks: Run ESLint with strict rules and fix all errors
Run TypeScript in strict mode and fix all errors
Check for dead code and remove it
Identify duplicate code and refactor
Verify consistent naming conventions
Check for proper error boundaries in React
Audit component structure for maintainability
Verify proper TypeScript types (no 'any' except justified)
Check for proper async/await error handling
Review and update dependencies
Check for circular dependencies
Verify proper code documentation

phases.name: Email System Verification
tasks: Verify Resend API key is valid and active
Test all email templates render correctly
Verify emails are sent for all booking scenarios
Check email deliverability (SPF, DKIM, DMARC)
Test email templates on multiple clients (Gmail, Outlook, Apple Mail)
Verify unsubscribe links work (if applicable)
Check for proper error handling when emails fail
Verify admin notifications are sent
Test scheduled emails (pre-trip, post-trip)
Audit email content for personalization accuracy

phases.name: Production Readiness Checklist
tasks: Verify all environment variables are set in production
Check error monitoring is configured (Sentry, LogRocket, etc.)
Verify analytics is properly configured
Check SSL certificate is valid
Verify proper caching configuration
Check CDN configuration for static assets
Verify backup strategy for database
Check disaster recovery plan
Verify proper logging in production
Check health check endpoints exist
Verify proper 404 and 500 error pages
Check sitemap and robots.txt are correct

execution_rules: Execute phases in order - each phase depends on the previous
Do NOT skip any task - mark as N/A with justification if not applicable
Fix issues immediately upon discovery - don't just list them
Verify each fix with a test before moving on
Document all changes in a CHANGELOG
Commit changes after each phase with descriptive messages
If blocked, document the blocker and continue with other tasks
Create GitHub issues for items requiring external input
Update documentation after each significant change

quick_start_command: /prompt Conduct a comprehensive optimization and testing maturity audit of this codebase. Execute ALL 8 phases in order: (1) Database Optimization, (2) API Endpoint Audit, (3) Frontend Performance, (4) Testing Infrastructure, (5) Security Audit, (6) Code Quality, (7) Email System Verification, (8) Production Readiness. For each phase: identify all issues, fix them immediately, add tests to prevent regression, and document changes. Do not skip any section. Target: 80%+ test coverage, 90+ Lighthouse scores, 0 security vulnerabilities, all API endpoints validated. Output a final report with metrics.

abbreviated_prompts.database_only: Audit and optimize the database: check indexes, query performance, RLS policies, and schema integrity. Fix all issues found.
abbreviated_prompts.api_only: Audit all API endpoints in app/api/**: verify error handling, input validation, response consistency, and security. Fix all issues.
abbreviated_prompts.testing_only: Audit and improve test coverage: add unit tests for utils, integration tests for APIs, E2E tests for booking flows. Target 80%+ coverage.
abbreviated_prompts.security_only: Run comprehensive security audit: npm audit, check env vars, audit auth flow, verify CORS/CSP, check RLS policies. Fix all vulnerabilities.
abbreviated_prompts.performance_only: Run Lighthouse on all pages, optimize images, reduce bundle size, fix re-renders, improve Web Vitals. Target 90+ scores.

known_issues: Some ESLint warnings for unused variables
Pre-existing lint issues in admin components
